title: Hume · TTS and EVI API sunset
summary: Hume says TTS and EVI API access ends 13 November 2026 at 12:01 a.m. EST. Account data will be permanently deleted after 13 November.
implication: An older notice missing from the previous review, not a new launch. Workflows using these APIs need a replacement and a plan for needed account data before the deadline. The notice says both APIs remain fully supported until then.

title: Higgsfield Ad Multiplier gets a visual workflow
summary: A new visual interface in Ads Studio turns a reference video into ad variations with changed products, cast, setting, script, hooks or CTAs. This expands access to an existing workflow; it is not a newly established model release.
implication: Useful for planning repeatable ad variants. Availability is documented by the vendor; retention of timing and structure is a vendor claim, with no independent output test here.

title: Higgsfield Katana brings preset video edits to Claude
summary: Higgsfield lists Katana as released October 8: preset-driven edits from reference images through its Claude MCP skill. The October 12 article explains the workflow; it is not the launch date.
implication: A workflow and integration change worth tracking for repeatable motion styles. Access instructions are public, but no account, generation or quality test was performed.

title: ElevenCreative Brand Kit stores shared visual direction
summary: ElevenLabs says Brand Kit is available now: teams can reuse visual assets and rules across Image & Video, Flows and the ElevenCreative agent. Voice and sound support are explicitly future work.
implication: Relevant to a consistent look across a film or campaign. This is a visual workflow feature, not evidence of a better speech model. Plan access and brand consistency were not independently tested.

title: Higgsfield · AI Influencer rebuild
date: 02 Oct release · 03 Oct blog · corrected 12 Oct
summary: Carryover from the 5 October review. a 19-setting character builder, paired portrait/full-body output and Genjutsu motion tools in the same studio.
implication: Workflow update. The vendor documents present availability and reuse in Cinema Studio; account access, identity consistency and motion quality have not been tested. Official changelog dates the release one day before the blog: https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/changelog

title: Runway · Seedance 2.5 Draft Mode
summary: Carryover from the 5 October review. Agent can generate 480p drafts and enhance them after generation, with a toggle for Draft Mode.
implication: Generation-workflow integration, not a new base model. Faster/cheaper iteration is a vendor claim; draft-to-final continuity and cost per accepted shot remain untested.

title: Runway · ElevenLabs v4 integration
summary: Carryover from the 5 October review. Runway documents ElevenLabs v4 support for audio generation. The integration predates the 2 October check.
implication: Access expansion, not another voice-model launch. Eleven v4 launched on 28 September and was already covered; no listening test or independent quality comparison was performed.

title: OpenArt · FLUX 3 Image
summary: Carryover from the 5 October review. Already covered on 2 October: OpenArt documents multi-reference image generation/editing and 2K/4K output.
implication: Carryover documentation, not fresh October 5 release news. The global launch date and exact integration time are unverified; edit-preservation and identity quality remain vendor claims.

title: Higgsfield · Ads Studio
date: 30 Sep release · 01 Oct blog · corrected 12 Oct
summary: Carryover from the 5 October review. Already covered on 2 October: reusable brand kits and product inputs generate batches of static-ad concepts and variations.
implication: Carryover workflow launch, not a new video model. Compare brand consistency and useful variation; authenticated availability and output quality have not been tested. Official changelog dates the release one day before the blog: https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/changelog
